body: The project workspace system segment already exposes member management and forwards projectId, with real add/remove/role APIs. Fixed the remaining route-context leak: ProjectMembersView now reloads when projectId changes, clears the old project's rows immediately, resets operation errors, and uses a request sequence guard so late responses from the previous project cannot overwrite the current member list or loading state. RED reproduced listMembers remaining on project 1 after switching to project 2. GREEN: target 3 files/18 tests. Full frontend baseline: 99 files/859 tests. vue-tsc and git diff check exited 0.
